title: Proving the Contendership
narrativeText: You've earned the shot. But first, another challenger stands between you and the title match. {{RIVAL}} has been here longer than you and doesn't think you've paid enough dues.

choices.label: Prove Your Worth
choices.text: Every match in this circuit has been a dues payment.

title: The Outsider's Title Shot
narrativeText: The ATW Extreme Championship. The champion — {{CHAMP}} — stands across the ring. They built this division. They own this ring. And you, an outsider, are about to take it all from them.

title: Defending the Unthinkable
narrativeText: An outsider holding the Extreme Championship. The extreme icons are furious. {{RIVAL}} demands the first shot — and they're not asking nicely.

choices.label: Defend Your Championship
choices.text: You didn't come this far to hand it back.

title: No Rest for the Champion
narrativeText: Another challenger. Another extreme brawler who thinks an outsider has no right to their title. Every defense makes the story more remarkable.

choices.label: Keep the Title
choices.text: You'll defend it against everyone. Every. Single. One.
